records.method: Pillow layout of original real-product synthetic screenshots; only whole-image scaling, rounded outer masking, neutral background, drop shadow and external captions. Screenshot wording/pixels not edited; no invented UI.

visualReview.cover: 1200x750 bounded preview inspected. Both full app screens retained side by side; labels and bottom captions not clipped; calm pale green background and subtle shadows; screenshot words not modified. Screenshot small text primarily intended for detail view.
visualReview.detail: 1129x1280 bounded preview inspected from 1200x1360 original. All five Ged messages, Pocket visible paragraph/headings and empty composer readable; no overlap/clipping. Explicit Ged 0.6.3 (16) screenshot version at bottom.
visualReview.boundary: Visual review establishes screenshot source/layout/privacy for public portfolio, not real-user adoption, model response quality, or a new device run.

captureCaveats: One second-pass chenchen.fangs.cc navigation timed out at45s; first pass and a separate fresh-context retry succeeded. Timeout evidence retained in chenchen-atelier-timeout.json. All delivered covers use final successful captures.
